windows.text: Dealing with somebody else’s emotional insecurities can also be exhausting. It’s easy to feel free when I don’t have to do that, especially since I’m a bit of an introvert and 10% autistic.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: All that works wonderfully until I’m in a romantic relationship and suddenly I’m expected to mind-read, check in constantly, notice every emotional shift (and what a silence means), and never use all that expert “management” to manipulate anyone.
